title: Atoms and molecules - 123 school
heading: Atoms and molecules
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.
Only use BINAS when the question names a BINAS table.

questions.q: What is an atom?
questions.a: A building block from which molecules are made

questions.q: What is a molecule?
questions.a: A particle made up of two or more atoms. The molecule determines the properties of the substance.

questions.q: What do you call a substance in which all atoms are of the same kind?
What do you call a substance in which the molecules consist of different kinds of atoms?
Is water an element or a compound?
questions.a: A compound: the molecule consists of two kinds of atoms (hydrogen and oxygen).

questions.q: Is oxygen gas (O<sub>2</sub>) an element or a compound?
questions.a: An element: the molecule consists of two atoms of the same kind.

questions.a: For example: F (fluorine), Cl (chlorine), Br (bromine), I (iodine)

questions.q: Which gas belongs to the noble gases?
questions.a: For example helium (He), neon (Ne) or argon (Ar)

What does the 2 in H<sub>2</sub>O mean?
questions.a: The 2 is a subscript: there are 2 hydrogen atoms in 1 molecule.

questions.q: What does the 3 in 3 CO<sub>2</sub> mean?
questions.a: The 3 is a coefficient: there are 3 molecules of CO<sub>2</sub>.
